description: Repaint this north-eastern arctic sea as one continuous frozen ocean seen from above: pale pack-ice and floes in the upper area breaking up into scattered small dark rocky skerries and open teal sea toward the lower-right. Remove the straight horizontal comb-like row of ticks and the straight vertical boundary; there must be no straight lines and no speckled noise band. Keep the same white, dark-rock and teal palette and the same pixel-art style as the surrounding ice and water.
